title: Finite-window relative coefficient approximation property
statement:
Let $B,A$ be commutative rings, $b:B\to A$ a ring map, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For a $B$-algebra $E$ put $X_E=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}B}\operatorname{Spec}E$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the finite-window relative coefficient approximation property $\mathcal P_b(f)$ as follows. For every commutative finite type $B$-algebra $D$ with a specified map $D\to A$ over $B$, every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X_A})$ pseudo-coherent relative to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-pc-derived-category], [def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex], and every $a\in\mathbf Z$, there exist a finite type $D$-algebra $D'$ with a factorization $D\to D'\to A$ and $F\in D(\mathcal O_{X_{D'}})$ with bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent], and a morphism $\gamma:F\to R\pi_*K$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], where $\pi:X_A\to X_{D'}$ is projection. Put $q:X_{D'}\to\operatorname{Spec}D'$ and $M=\widetilde A[0]$ on $\operatorname{Spec}D'$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. The morphism
$$\theta:Lq^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}F\longrightarrow R\pi_*K$$
is defined by adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] from
$$L\pi^*(Lq^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}F)\simeq L(q\pi)^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\pi^*F\longrightarrow\mathcal O_{X_A}\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\simeq K,$$
using the given $A$-structure and the transpose of $\gamma$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Its cone [def-weil-triangulated-category] has quasi-coherent cohomology and zero cohomology sheaves in every degree $i\geq a$. There is no flatness requirement on $B\to A$, $D\to A$ or $D'\to A$. The canonical derived tensor comparison is the K-flat normalized comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]; composition and adjunction use the pinned comparisons [def-sfb-canonical-scheme-derived-adjunction-composition], and the map from derived to ordinary pullback on a module in degree zero is [def-weil-pbc-canonical-single-pullback-map].
